subject: Shiny server very slow, what could cause this?

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Shiny server very slow, what could cause this?
parts:
I have shiny server installed on a web server. The past couple days, it has gotten really slow (i.e. apps don't even display ). I've noticed that node is using a fair bit of memory (1.5G) and am not sure if this is normal. My understanding is that node is simply handling requests (and the actual apps would be individual apps in separate R processes) so I don't know what would be causing this. Would an app doing something intensive/having a lot of data in it cause this issue?

Restarting shiny server fixes this at first but it comes back.

Thanks,
Greg

  3. How long has Shiny Server been running, to get up to 1.5GB?

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server very slow, what could cause this?
parts:
I restarted the server instance and split two instances into two separate calls (i.e. I had 2 instances in my .conf file). I also removed some apps. This seemed to have worked but not sure what the underlying issue.

Also, I realized that the issue was not memory but CPU usage - it was consistently at 99% and now, when working, it only spikes when there is an app request.
